name: Lowfin Companion
overview: Completion, resume, incremental cache, cover tags and Discord presence
description: Per-user completion rules and independent resume positions for Lowfin. Requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer.

versions.changelog: Dashboard sidebar with the original Lowfin L, reorganized settings, optional per-user Discord presence with original-compatible gateway discovery, large READY support, encrypted token storage, original upstream cover rendering/upload/cache, live TV programme timing and no standalone import, plus Jellyfin 12.3 compatibility; minimum server version remains 12.2.
